Hi all, question about citizenship application (MH Jerusalem). I received my first A5 Visa on March 20 2023 hence I'm about to finish my fourth year on an A5 visa. However my current A5 visa expires only in June 6 2027. When can I apply for citizenship and when will I realistically be able to receive it? In March or only in June 2027? Also, when should I apply for it? 3 months before the end of the fourth year or 3 months before the end of my current visa?

Thanks in advance!
